sample_notice: LAYOUT SAMPLE. Fictional 'Sample Co', not an analysis of any listed company.

business.headline: Sample Co makes components in two segments; Segment A is 62% of revenue.
points: Segment A 62%, Segment B 38% of revenue [AR p.12]

financial.headline: Revenue Rs 18,400 cr, EBITDA margin 4.1%, PAT Rs 560 cr (FY25).

trajectory.headline: Revenue compounding at 38% over 3 years, margins flat.

balance_sheet.headline: Low debt, but working capital is stretching.

cash_quality.headline: Cash conversion weak: 5y CFO is 62% of PAT.
points: Cum CFO Rs 1,400 cr vs PAT Rs 2,250 cr

narrative_vs_numbers.headline: Volume promises mostly delivered; margin promises missed twice.

guidance.headline: Management guides growth, avoids margin numbers.
